name: civivision-root
description: Root workspace to launch ML service, backend, and frontend simultaneously

scripts.start: concurrently -n "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "uvicorn ml.api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan,green" "uvicorn ml.api:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
